title: Sometimes when I dismiss an alert notification, the alert is not snoozed.
symptom: When dismissing an alert notification, sometimes the alert is not snoozed.
cause: The alert was canceled within the minimum limit of 3 seconds, which is a safeguard against apps with Notification Access programmatically canceling notifications.
fix: The user should wait more than 3 seconds before dismissing the alert to allow snoozing to work.
evidence_quote: I assume you did cancel the alarm within 3 seconds. In my tests I found it very difficult to cancel the alarm by hand within 3 seconds which is why the limit is set there as a balance between the maximum of how long an app might take to cancel it and the minimum a human might do.
